items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 25, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: But what CNN told me yesterday, along with Fauci and Sanjay Gupta was we’re getting worse, we’re not getting better.

ctx.x: I appreciate your eloquent opinions. Just to wrap up, were you in the position, when all the cancellations of gigs started coming in, usually you were told, okay the gig is off, the thing is cancelled. Did you have to cancel anything yourself, out of feeling for your own protection or the thinking of your sidemen or whatever else?

Well yeah I had a number of scenarios in that, so I conduct the Columbus Jazz Orchestra and the week that the State of Ohio, the governor did a great thing and the day before our first concert he said no venues of a thousand or more can have people there. Our concerts run four nights: Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. I had two guest artists in and my full band had already done four rehearsals with those guest artists to present the concert. On Thursday, the day we were supposed to start, the governor said,…

He said, “I feel fine but I could be one of those asymptomatic guys.” And you know I just weighed that, and it was like we can’t do this. We can’t put those people on stage.
